messages.author: ab8277113f65c05e
messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] regarding threshold number of cytosine in a tiles
parts:
Hi,
I don't have structured investigation for this, so don't have a great answer for the cutoff. One can look at tiles that have many cytosines covered, and remove one cytosine at time, to see how the aggregated methylation values are changing and find a lower bound. 

This is also related to number of CpGs in the tile, sometimes there will be only one CpG occurring in a tile. 

Another strategy is to have cutoff on total coverage of CpGs on a tile and forgetting about number of CpGs.

Best,
Altuna
